Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers and pet plans

Travelers should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before they head to the airport so we can sort out pet details with care. We keep the process calm, practical, and clear, and we want every animal to travel as smoothly as possible.

Please bring any paperwork that matches the pet's travel setup, and make sure the crate or carrier is ready for a safe ride. <<FACT F072>> If your trip includes a large dog, <<FACT F057>> Our team will walk you through the steps in plain words and help you avoid last-minute trouble.

If you need help with a booking, crate check, or pet travel question, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
